body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Motorola presented ''S705 SoundPilot'', its Bluetooth stereo headphone combined with a remote control during CES 2007. The remote control functionality allows users to take control of the music playback and voice communication.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
